violations.text: Dried corn kernels were observed with grain moths. Food was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Molluscan shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Raw animal foods such as eggs, raw chicken and raw fish were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods such as herbs and vegetables, cooked clams and cooked rice in the reach-in refrigerators. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Items were replaced during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Cooked clams and mussels were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked (establishment serves ceviche (raw seafood) and steak cooked to customer's preference. New Violation. Correct By: 11/26/2026
Residential insecticide sprays were observed in establishment. PIC informed to cease practice. Spray was voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered; apparent large quantity of flies were observed in and around dumpster. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. Lid was closed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Shellfish tags must be maintained for 90 days in chronological order and the date when the last shellfish was used from the bag must be noted on the shellfish tag. During inspection the shellfish tags were observed without the date of last sold from original container. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024

Various food items were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the 1-door reach-in unit. Refrigerator door gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 01/11/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the 2-door reach-in fan guards have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/11/2024

The hot water handle for the hand sink by the ice machine was observed broken and unable to open valve for hot water. Establishment is to repair or replace handle. New Violation. Correct By: 12/18/2024
